## ReferenceList type

A materialized collection: an array whose reference entries are already decided.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ReferenceList<R extends ObjectReference<unknown>> = readonly R[]
```

**References:** [ObjectReference](./contracts.objectreference.md)

## Remarks

Not itself resolvable; each entry resolves independently. It is neither a data snapshot nor an immutable identity of its targets.
